nodes.text: I want to talk to you.
Sam turns back toward Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Let's `talk.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. Let's [color=#3b78e2][i]talk.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What did I do wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you do wrong?! What did you do `wrong?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What did you do wrong?! What did you do [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about the entire Homecoming dance?! How about every time I see you, you look like you're about to knock someone's head off with that stupid, angry expression of yours?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about you can't design a normal, fun pumpkin, even when I specifically asked you to?!
Spencer glares at Ben!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There you go again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, hey, since we're talking about relationships... What's going on with you and Denni?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, have you gotten that second kiss yet?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You mean his second make-out session?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, I mean his second kiss. Period.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... I don't know if I want to talk about it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You can't be doing any worse than I am!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a valid point.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No... We haven't yet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've gotta do it, man! Prolonging your second kiss is like a bandage! The longer you wait to rip it off... The more uncomfortable the two of you get!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure that makes medical sense.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You know what I mean!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, Ben will kiss Denni again when he's ready. Let's join up with the girls.
The guys head into the living room to join the girls...
Spencer sits down next to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Sam turns her body purposefully away from Spencer...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? You too?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I don't exactly have the most experience on the matter...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No kidding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But Howard and Hector are, like, relationship masters!
Hector bows.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You must apologize, Grasshopper Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. Only then can you achieve relationship, uh... Harmony.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I get it.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ha!
Spencer smiles arrogantly at Howard and Hector.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale here agrees with me, and he's a genius!
Hector and Howard shake their heads...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What should I say though?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Just ask what you did wrong...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously, bro. Do `not` do that! It's like... It's like...
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously, bro. Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] do that! It's like... It's like...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like stepping on a landmine while pulling the pin on a grenade.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Bingo.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whatever. I think I'll go with the smartest guy in the room.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Is that supposed to be our pumpkin? It looks like a droopy blob... Or a blobby droop...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... I... I guess it does.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Maybe we're not the best team. I mean, even Spencer and Sam's pumpkin looks like something!
Ben makes the final cut. He and Denni take a step back from their pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think?
Ben carves haphazardly along his penciled drawing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know we actually want it to look like something, right?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, I know... I'm just not very good at this...
Ben carefully carves along his penciled drawing...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who knew you had this super valuable skill?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Forget school! I'll become a pumpkin-carver!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... The last step is to carve out the design...
Ben slowly pencils in the design of the pumpkin until its complete!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow! Steady Hand Ben! It looks just like `our` pumpkin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow! Steady Hand Ben! It looks just like [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's nice when the model is also the canvas!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You are `such` a nerd.
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]such[/i][/color] a nerd.

nodes.text: Ben scribbles the pumpkin design in a rush!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Don't you think we should maybe take our time with the drawing phase there, Picasso?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Just move on. You've got the gist of a pumpkin at least...
Ben stares at the pumpkin, pencil in hand...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... Are you going to draw something or just imagine it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah yeah, of course...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess the next step is to draw on the pumpkin design...
Ben stops after just a few more scoops...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What's the matter?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it really necessary to scoop it `all` out?
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it really necessary to scoop it [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] out?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What?! If you don't scoop it out, it ends up looking all stringy!
Denni grabs the scooper from Ben and gets all the rest of the seeds and gunk out of the pumpkin.
Ben scoops out all of the seeds and gunk from inside the pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is so gross.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's like we're horrible pumpkin surgeons...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This guy's a goner.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hahaha!
Ben stops mid-scoop, feeling queasy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Are you seriously going to vomit from scooping out a pumpkin?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I can carve it, that is, unless you consider yourself to be a carver-extraordinaire!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now's my chance to impress Denni!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll carve it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Then I will advise you... Like a back-seat carver!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Commence the carving of meta-pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: For my first bit of backseat advice, I'd like to remind you that all we have to do is hollow out the inside `completely`, draw the pumpkin design `slowly`, and carve it out `carefully.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For my first bit of backseat advice, I'd like to remind you that all we have to do is hollow out the inside [color=#3b78e2][i]completely[/i][/color], draw the pumpkin design [color=#3b78e2][i]slowly[/i][/color], and carve it out [color=#3b78e2][i]carefully.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got it! Thanks!
Ben starts scooping out the inside of the pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? That doesn't sound very fun...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It will be, trust me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay... But won't it just be three circles with some lines connecting them... Like a fancy triangle?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I hadn't thought about the actual design. It's just my favorite molecule.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, that happens. We all get blinded from time to time by the idea of designing our favorite molecule.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Are you making fun of me?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh! I know! Why don't we do a pumpkin `in` a pumpkin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh! I know! Why don't we do a pumpkin [color=#3b78e2][i]in[/i][/color] a pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That `does` sound a lot more fun...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] sound a lot more fun...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay... Ummm... I know! Let's carve a pumpkin design into our pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. A pumpkin in a pumpkin! I like it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Come on in everyone!
The doorbell rings! Ben opens the front door...
Standing on his front porch are Howard and $ZOE, Hector and Amanda, and Spencer and Sam!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm back! With friends!
Ben escorts the group from the foyer into the living room...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You live `here,` Kale? No wonder I punched you so much!
nodes.text_bbcode: You live [color=#e23b3b][i]here,[/i][/color] Kale? No wonder I punched you so much!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh my gosh! It's so perfect! Everything's so beautiful and Halloween-y and its going to be so much fun to see everyone dancing in their costumes!
$ZOE gives Howard a squeeze!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It's like we're Kings and Queens!
Amanda points her finger at no one in particular.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: 'Servant, I demand a royal dance! Prepare my golden unicorn for the ride home tonight! And have all the royal scones from my kitchen for being `so` helpful!'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Servant, I demand a royal dance! Prepare my golden unicorn for the ride home tonight! And have all the royal scones from my kitchen for being [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] helpful!'

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! Isn't this the best, Hector?!
Amanda puts her arms around Hector.
Howard and Hector both nod at Ben and smile!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good theme, dogg.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What do you think, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Meh... Once you've lived in a boarding school that accepts diamonds for cafeteria credit, opulence is kind of lost on you...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Still, the masks are creepy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You have Denni to thank for those!
Denni steps into the living room...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did I hear my name?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh... I was just saying the masks are kinda creepy... In a good way, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's get started with the first annual pre-party pumpkin carving-o-thon!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: As long as we don't hurt any pumpkins!
Each of the four couples gets a pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What kind of pumpkin should we carve?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was thinking we could try to make...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A duck?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was going to say, 'Two ducks'!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard, I love you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I know, right? Let's carve a guy throwing up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew... Seriously, what should we carve?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! Let's carve a fist into our pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's not. Why don't we just make a regular jack o' lantern?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Like with blood coming out of it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gross. No. Just a normal, fun pumpkin.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That doesn't sound very fun...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's in the name!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you wanna carve, Manda-Panda? A kitten? A unicorn? A kitten riding a unicorn?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A vampire kitten!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? You mean a kitten that... That drinks blood?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! People get close to it cause it's `soooo` cute, and then it goes 'mew', and attacks!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! People get close to it cause it's [color=#3b78e2][i]soooo[/i][/color] cute, and then it goes 'mew', and attacks!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then the people `become` kittens! Everyone becomes a kitten! Yay!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then the people [color=#3b78e2][i]become[/i][/color] kittens! Everyone becomes a kitten! Yay!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't know if we'll have time to carve all that...
Meanwhile, Ben and Denni stare at their pumpkin...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So... This pumpkin isn't going to cut itself open! What should we carve?
Suddenly, Sam snaps at Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you do to the teeth on our pumpkin?! They're all sharp!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What's wrong with that? It's a monster!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh! Why can't you just make a fun pumpkin like I wanted to in the first place!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Because this pumpkin is fun to me!
Sam storms off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, girls.
The girls leave to console Sam...
Spencer turns to Howard and Hector...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What is up with her?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Man, I have seen this before!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, she's upset about something, but it has `nothing` to do with the thing that just happened.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, she's upset about something, but it has [color=#e23b3b][i]nothing[/i][/color] to do with the thing that just happened.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What? That's confusing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's `girls,` Spence.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]girls,[/i][/color] Spence.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's usually best to just say you're sorry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, that's usually your best bet...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What?! But I don't even know what I did wrong! I'm not going to just apologize!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where are your spines?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's not about machismo, dogg...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Right now, your girl is a shark, and `you` are blood in the water. 'Sorry' is like dumping a bucket of blood in the water a mile away. It gives her something else to feed on first.
nodes.text_bbcode: Right now, your girl is a shark, and [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] are blood in the water. 'Sorry' is like dumping a bucket of blood in the water a mile away. It gives her something else to feed on first.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: By the time she gets to you, she's not nearly as hungry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Kinda dark, Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's Halloween!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He's right, though. 'Sorry' does diffuse things. Afterwards, you can discuss what's wrong with level heads.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about you, Kale? You always know stuff.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me? Um... I'm not an expert, but I think you should...
Meanwhile, on the other side of the room, Ben walks up to Denni...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: All ready?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Everything except for my costume...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think it's going to be a great party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks! I'm... I'm really glad you're here...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Me too!
The doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The guests!
Ben scrambles to the door and opens it!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Party at the new guy's house!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I've been a student at Centerscore for a while now...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Party!
And later, the doorbell rings again!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm here! The party can officially begin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Was I supposed to wait for you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Minus one point for carelessness. If you were on the cheer squad, you'd be on a collision course with the bottom of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on in, girls!
The rest of the cheerleaders file into Ben's house...
And again...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Sorry, we're late. But `someone` had to try on like a hundred outfits!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, we're late. But [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] had to try on like a hundred outfits!

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: I like to make an effort. Not that you ever notice.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I `notice!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]notice![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Computer
nodes.text: Then why did you not comment on my new processor?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Grr!
Ryan glares at Ben...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I'll get you back for this!
Ben steps back inside and looks around his house, which is now packed!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Come into this room over here if you want to tell ghost stories in the dark!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I've got a waiting list for storytellers!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oooh! I want to tell one!
A couple of cheerleaders walk past Ben...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This house is `so` cool! It's like a mansion!
nodes.text_bbcode: This house is [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool! It's like a mansion!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I love all the spider webs and masks!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Look at all the fancy masks everyone's wearing! I feel like we've been transported back to the Renaissance.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I guess the party started!
Hector comes up to him...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man! Good start!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But... Check it out...
Hector points to one of Ben's couches. Maria and Nicole are sitting on it, talking...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They look like they're having a good time...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I know. But looks can be perceiving.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I don't think that's the right word.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Classic error, bro. Idle chatter at a party leads to criticism!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You want the party to be so wild that people only talk about it `after!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You want the party to be so wild that people only talk about it [color=#e23b3b][i]after![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How do I fix it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean how do you get girls off a couch?! Easy... Music!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know if `wild` is what I want, but I definitely need to play some music... The question is... What should I play?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if [color=#e23b3b][i]wild[/i][/color] is what I want, but I definitely need to play some music... The question is... What should I play?

nodes.text: Ben immediately heads for the dance floor, hoping to find Denni, but Hector cuts him off!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Not any of my books... Physics might be too advanced for them.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think it's too advanced for most people!
From the porch...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We don't have all day! It's gonna be past our bedtime!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: I hope he gets something good!
Back inside, Ben keeps searching...
He sees...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My MP3 player!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hmmm... Better not! I think they'd just end up fighting over it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Plus, then `you'd` be unhappy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, then [color=#3b78e2][i]you'd[/i][/color] be unhappy!

nodes.text: Meanwhile...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: This had better be good! We're missing out on other houses!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: All that potential candy!
Back inside, Ben runs into the dining room and finds...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Silver spoons!
Ben closes the door...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Those girls are a handful!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Did you see their dad?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What about him?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He was `there` for them. My dad used to be like that...
nodes.text_bbcode: He was [color=#e23b3b][i]there[/i][/color] for them. My dad used to be like that...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I remember this one Halloween I was really scared of this haunted house. But he reassured me and took me through it, holding my hand the whole way.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Before something would pop out to try and scare me, he'd warn me about it, and that made it better. He... He made things okay.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Aww... I'm sorry, Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's okay... Seeing their dad just now reminded me why I wanted to throw this party in the first place...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad's not here, he's `never` here, and even when he is, he might as well be on a trip. If I don't want to end up like him, I need `true` popularity! I'm ready!
nodes.text_bbcode: My dad's not here, he's [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] here, and even when he is, he might as well be on a trip. If I don't want to end up like him, I need [color=#e23b3b][i]true[/i][/color] popularity! I'm ready!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But Ben, popularity isn't what you need. You already know that...
The doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's Hector!
Ben lets Hector in! Hector stops when he gets to the living room, his jaw open!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! You have outdone yourself, Ben! I heard, like, four cheerleaders talking about how excited they were for your party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Nice? Why is that nice exactly?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant nice just because that means a lot of people will be coming tonight!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh! Hey, I forgot! I brought a special stereo for your party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome! How do we get it set up?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, `we` is a funny word here...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]we[/i][/color] is a funny word here...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You're not going to help me set it up?!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've gotta go pick up the rest of the gang for pre-party pumpkin carving.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? I didn't plan any pumpkin carving!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Neither did I! I just thought of it right now! New tradition! Boom!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But how am I going to get this stereo set up?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Relax, man, relax! The instructions are right here!
Hector hands Ben an instruction manual...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: These are in Japanese!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You're smart! I'm sure you can figure it out! The picture explains a lot too!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is a picture of an octopus eating a baseball bat!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See? That means don't, um, submerge your stereo in water...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No it doesn't!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, gotta go! Be back soon! Good luck with the system!
Hector scampers out the front door!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great! Just when I thought I had everything planned out, something unexpected showed up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's how unexpected things work, Ben...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You can't plan everything...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess not... I just... I don't know how I'm going to set this up in time for the party!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We'll do it together...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay...
After Ben and Denni have read over the instructions...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: There's a lot here, but I think I've got it. Believe it or not, this octopus picture `is` helpful.
nodes.text_bbcode: There's a lot here, but I think I've got it. Believe it or not, this octopus picture [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] helpful.

nodes.text: Having attained popularity by sitting at the Center Table, Ben comes home, flushed with pride.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Dad! I'm home, and ready for cake baking!
No one answers.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: ...Dad?
Ben wanders into the kitchen, where a note has been left on the dining room table.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: 'Dear Ben, some urgent business came up, so I'm going out of town. I'll be back in two weeks. From Dad.'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He didn't even say anything about our plans for tonight.
Ben takes out his phone and dials Hector.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hector... About that party...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Let's throw it at `my house.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's throw it at [color=#e23b3b][i]my house.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's what I like to hear! If you're going to achieve `legendary` party-throwing status like me or $Scott, you're going to have to throw one `impressive` party!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I like to hear! If you're going to achieve [color=#e23b3b][i]legendary[/i][/color] party-throwing status like me or $Scott, you're going to have to throw one [color=#e23b3b][i]impressive[/i][/color] party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm up for it! I'm thinking we could have a punch bowl so we can bob for candy apples! Oh! And a haunted area where we blindfold guests and have them feel gross things!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, like we make them touch spaghetti, but we tell them that it's really brains...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah! I get it! It's kind of like when you invite people to a party saying it'll be cool, but really, it's super lame!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Bobbing for apples isn't cool?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Not unless you're a bored sixth-grader or a hungry pig!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, your dad's rich, right? That house of yours has gotta be impressive. Take advantage!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um... I'm not sure I know how. I've never thrown a party... Let alone a legendary one.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But you're a smart guy. It's not rock science!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean rocket science? Or geology?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: There you go again, being smart!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, all legendary parties have a unique theme. That theme `has` to be impressive to the ladies...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, all legendary parties have a unique theme. That theme [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] to be impressive to the ladies...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Guys will go to a party in a landfill as long as it has food and girls. But girls will only come to a party if the theme is right.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't really care that much about `girls.` I care more about `Denni...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't really care that much about [color=#e23b3b][i]girls.[/i][/color] I care more about [color=#e23b3b][i]Denni...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can I talk to you about something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go for it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Denni... Denni and I haven't had our second kiss yet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean, like, your second kiss in a crazy location? For Amanda and me, our second crazy kiss was on two `separate` escalators!
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, like, your second kiss in a crazy location? For Amanda and me, our second crazy kiss was on two [color=#e23b3b][i]separate[/i][/color] escalators!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I was on the down escalator, she was on the up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No, no... I mean our second kiss, period.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa! That's... Slow, dude.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I'm not nearly as experienced as you.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude, this party is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, man, you're about to try and throw a Best Party Ever! And if you do, man, your stock will never be higher! She'll kiss you for sure!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But the party has to be legendary?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, yeah, girls want to kiss party studs, not party `duds!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, yeah, girls want to kiss party studs, not party [color=#e23b3b][i]duds![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, then I'd better get started right away! What kind of party should it be?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Whoa whoa whoa! This isn't something you just rush into. Halloween is a week away. You've got like six days to figure that out. Whatever you decide, I'll be there on Halloween night for the pre-party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks, Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Later, bro.
Ben ends the call.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Halloween is right around the corner! Hector may be all about throwing something spectacular together at the last minute, but I need a theme `now` so I can start preparing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Halloween is right around the corner! Hector may be all about throwing something spectacular together at the last minute, but I need a theme [color=#e23b3b][i]now[/i][/color] so I can start preparing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He said I needed a theme that's unique and impressive to girls... But what kind of party is that?
